articles.summary: Q3 revenue grew 43% year-over-year to $391.4 million, $16.4 million above the high-end of prior guidance. Figma, Inc. (NYSE:FIG) announced financial results today for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “As code becomes a commodity, value is moving up the stack to design—and our Q3 results reflect that,” said Dylan Field, Figma’s CEO and co-founder. “We're building the full-stack canvas for visual-first development: one that's built for collaboration, increasingly powered by our first-party model and native to the way teams design and build with AI. This is Figma's opportunity and what we believe will fuel our next phase of growth.” “Q3 revenue grew 43% year-over-year, coming in well ahead of our prior guidance as customers continued to expand seats and invest more deeply in Figma,” said Praveer Melwani, Figma’s CFO. “We’re seeing customers move from trying AI to making larger commitments, and the Figma agent is expanding how they use credits across our platform.
